result.title: One Scale, Four Texts: Gaps, Overlaps and Silent Repairs in Published Grading Schemes
result.summary: Category systems often reach their users as text, and readers apply them with tacit repairs. We ask what such a text determines once the repairs are removed, using diabetic retinopathy grading, where one international scale circulates in several documents. We transcribe four texts (the English screening definitions of 2025, the international scale as tabulated in 2017 and as published in 2003, and an Italian guideline of 2015) into one rule language over 24 finding variables, and make every point a text leaves open a named precisification. Exhaustive enumeration of 1,425,807,360 finding profiles, re-derived by an SMT solver and spot-checked by an OWL reasoner, shows that every text that assigns actions leaves some eyes without a category under every reading; that the 2017 tabulation has a proliferative class that is empty when read literally and a macular gap that the 2003 text lacks, so that no function maps the 2003 grades onto the 2017 grades; and that on image findings alone the English and Italian texts order some pairs of eyes in opposite ways. On 927 annotated photographs from three public datasets, with retinal thickening assumed absent, the English text and the 2017 tabulation disagree on referral for 26.8% of the eyes of one dataset (DDR) on which both decide, and in a pre-registered experiment classifiers trained on each text's labels side with their own text. Thickening cannot be seen on a colour photograph; left free, every disagreement involving England becomes undecidable, so it rests on what the camera cannot show. In a second pre-registered study, language models that answered without deliberating repaired most gap and overlap items even when told to read literally, while Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Opus 5.5 reported the defects far more often; within two models, deliberation reduced silent repair without removing it.

AI.brief_summary: 该文把四份糖尿病视网膜病变分级文本转写为统一规则语言，用穷举与 SMT 检验文本缺口、类别重叠及版本间无法映射之处，并在 927 张标注图像和两项预注册实验中比较不同文本标签下的分类器行为，以及语言模型有无审议时的「静默修补」。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「规范缺口」与「静默修补」概念可能启发 LVR 评价：可供核查生成的状态是在补全输入未指定的信息、还是依赖视觉证据，以及 deliberation 能否减少这种无证据填充。
